g.text: Persistent tuple-space roots, radix nodes, and cold leaves
prefix = rspace for chain state, eval for evaluator state.
Trie paths distinguish data, continuations, and joins before the channel hash.
Legacy mode uses rspace/casper/v2/{history,roots,cold,channels}, each named db.
Sources: roots_store.rs, radix_tree.rs, cold_store.rs, serializers.rs, rnode_key_value_store_manager.rs.
